method.diagnostic: Give the same dense and sparse events their exact authored edit span and signed timing change. Try the existing common-flank lag and count the first unmet condition before a flag. This uses known labels only for diagnosis.
method.points: Use each candidate's largest and second-largest speaker maxima among the frozen ordinary calibration deliveries, including uniform delays. Keep the prior sparse and dense cutoffs.
method.scale: Rescale each clip's dense aperture prediction to its observed 10th to 90th percentile independently. Keep the existing mouth-gap scale. The rank arm instead uses midranks on both series. Use the same 20 ms prediction cadence, 40 ms measurement grid, native pictures, timing search and range overlap.
method.transfer: Use the original GRID and matched PCM and AAC sources, the first 24 qualified native actors, and the remaining qualified native actors. The same frozen fitting and points apply.
method.wide_grid: After the first native diagnostic, lock a separate trial widening the absolute lag grid from ±240 ms to ±400 ms. Keep the signed local change requirement, score scales and interval search. Evaluate original aperture and clipwise ranks separately on this grid, including the held actors.
